title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the 2019 Work Priorities of the People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "2019 People's Court Work Priorities"

Fa Fa [2019] No. 7

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "2019 People's Court Work Priorities" is hereby issued for your earnest implementation.

January 24, 2019

2019 People's Court Work Priorities

2019 marks the 70th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, a key year for building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and achieving the first centenary goal. The overall work requirements are: adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the guide, fully implement the spirit of the 19th CPC National Congress and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th CPC Central Committee, the Central Economic Work Conference, the Third Plenary Session of the 19th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and the Central Conference on Political and Legal Affairs; adhere to the absolute leadership of the Party over the people's courts; enhance the Four Consciousnesses, strengthen the Four Confidences, and resolutely achieve the Two Upholds; closely focus on the goal of "letting the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case"; adhere to the people-centered development philosophy; adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability; adhere to serving the overall situation, administering justice for the people, and ensuring judicial fairness; comprehensively deepen judicial system reform and smart court construction; accelerate the construction of a revolutionary, regularized, professional, and specialized people's court team; fully leverage the adjudication function; fulfill the duties of safeguarding national political security, ensuring overall social stability, promoting social fairness and justice, and ensuring people's well-being; and greet the 70th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China with outstanding achievements.

I. Always Adhere to Arming the Mind, Guiding Practice, and Advancing Work with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era

1. Consistently and thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought and the spirit of the 19th CPC National Congress. Gain a deep and thorough understanding of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Persist in systematic, follow-up, and practice-linked study; make continuous and intensive efforts to truly understand, master, and apply the Thought; achieve new improvements in political competence, performance capacity, and sense of responsibility; continuously achieve new results in study and implementation; and effectively transform the learning outcomes into vivid practice that drives the people's courts to achieve new development in the new era.

2. Thoroughly study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech when he presided over the meeting of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and heard the work report of the Supreme People's Court Party Group. Effectively enhance the consciousness and resolve to achieve the Two Upholds; unify thoughts and actions with the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee; focus on the overall work of the Party and the state to fulfill duties and responsibilities; comprehensively deepen judicial system reform; and further strengthen the Party building and team building of the people's courts.

3. Enhance the Four Consciousnesses, strengthen the Four Confidences, and resolutely achieve the Two Upholds. Take a clear-cut stand on politics; resolutely uphold the core position of General Secretary Xi Jinping; resolutely uphold the authority and centralized, unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee. Conscientiously implement the Regulations on the Work of Political and Legal Affairs of the Communist Party of China; integrate the unwavering implementation of the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments with the independent and impartial exercise of adjudicative power in accordance with the law; and effectively embody the Two Upholds in practical actions of serving the overall situation, administering justice for the people, and ensuring judicial fairness. Conscientiously implement the responsibility system for ideological work; effectively safeguard ideological security in the judicial field. Firmly adhere to the absolute leadership of the Party over the people's courts; unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics.

4. Thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the Central Conference on Political and Legal Affairs. Thoroughly study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the Central Conference on Political and Legal Affairs; study and implement the spirit of the Central Conference on Political and Legal Affairs; unify thoughts and actions with the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission on political and legal affairs; effectively identify the integration points and focal points for adjudicative and enforcement work to serve the overall situation; and implement the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee with concrete measures.

5. Conscientiously implement the spirit of the National Conference of Presidents of Higher People's Courts. In accordance with the deployments of the National Conference of Presidents of Higher People's Courts, formulate work plans, break down and implement task requirements item by item; ensure that all decisions and deployments made at the conference are put into practice; make precise efforts to carry out all work of the people's courts; and provide strong judicial services and safeguards for sustained and healthy economic development and overall social stability.

II. Firmly Establish a Holistic Concept of National Security, Effectively Safeguard National Political Security and Overall Social Stability

6. Severely punish all types of criminal offenses. Strictly crack down on various criminal activities such as infiltration, subversion, destruction, violent terrorism, ethnic separatism, and religious extremism; resolutely safeguard national political security, especially regime security and institutional security. Severely punish serious violent crimes such as homicide, robbery, and kidnapping; increase penalties for crimes involving firearms and explosives, pornography, gambling, drugs, pyramid schemes, and trafficking; strictly crack down on crimes that are strongly reflected by the public, such as those endangering food and drug safety, polluting the environment, violent attacks on medical personnel, school bullying, and malicious wage arrears. Severely punish crimes endangering public safety, such as major accidents and dangerous driving; legally punish crimes that obstruct the safe driving of public transport vehicles; promote the enhancement of the people's sense of security. Severely punish crimes that disrupt financial management order and market order, such as fund-raising fraud and contract fraud; legally and properly handle cases involving economic crimes against a large number of people. Severely punish crimes of embezzlement and bribery; continuously improve the trial mechanism for duty-related crimes; strengthen the organic connection between judicial adjudication and state supervision; continue to cooperate in special operations for overseas pursuit of fugitives and asset recovery; maintain a high-pressure stance against corruption crimes. Severely punish crimes infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of women, children, and the elderly. Adhere to the policy of "education, persuasion, and redemption"; explore and improve trial methods suited to the physical and mental characteristics of minors; strengthen the adjudication of cases involving minors. Severely punish crimes such as telecom and internet fraud and trafficking in personal information; purify cyberspace.

7. Actively participate in the special campaign to combat organized crime and root out local mafia. Implement the policy of strict punishment according to law; impose severe and heavy punishments on organized crime forces and their "protective umbrellas"; resolutely crush the arrogance of organized crime forces; promote the comprehensive and in-depth development of the special campaign. Closely integrate the special campaign with maintaining the order of the socialist market economy and supporting and ensuring the development of private enterprises; accurately grasp the boundaries between law and policy. Closely integrate the special campaign with strengthening grassroots organization building; severely punish acts such as taking control of grassroots political power and manipulating or disrupting grassroots elections; eradicate the breeding ground for organized crime forces.

8. Conscientiously implement the Criminal Procedure Law. Fully implement the revised content of the Criminal Procedure Law; strengthen study and training; accurately grasp the scope of application and procedures of criminal trials in absentia; correctly apply the leniency system for pleading guilty and accepting punishment and the expedited adjudication procedure. Establish a scientific concept of criminal justice; adhere to strict and fair justice; ensure the unity of procedural justice and substantive justice. Actively respond to social concerns; adhere to the organic integration of reason, law, and sentiment; ensure that case outcomes withstand scrutiny.

9. Strengthen judicial protection of human rights. Strictly implement legal principles and systems such as nulla poena sine lege, the presumption of innocence, adjudication based on evidence, and exclusion of illegally obtained evidence. Improve the mechanism for effective prevention and timely correction of wrongful convictions; strictly control the facts, evidence, procedures, and application of law in cases. Strengthen the protection of lawyers' right to practice; deeply advance the pilot program of full-coverage defense counsel for criminal cases; better leverage the role of lawyers in preventing wrongful convictions and promoting fair justice.

III. Fully Implement the New Development Concept, Create a Sound Legal Environment for High-Quality Development

10. Legally serve the fight against the three major battles (major risk prevention, targeted poverty alleviation, pollution prevention). Legally serve the prevention and resolution of major risks; properly adjudicate financial cases; strictly crack down on crimes such as illegal fundraising, online pyramid schemes, and insider trading; promote the resolution of difficulties in financing for private enterprises; enhance the capacity and level of financial adjudication. Legally serve the battle against poverty; precisely align with the judicial needs of poverty alleviation work; legally adjudicate cases involving impoverished areas and people in need; properly handle judicial work related to deeply impoverished areas such as the "three regions and three prefectures" and special poverty-stricken groups. Severely punish corruption crimes in the field of poverty alleviation, especially criminal acts such as embezzling, misappropriating, intercepting, secretly distributing, or falsely claiming poverty alleviation funds; legally safeguard the safety of poverty alleviation funds and the legitimate rights and interests of the people. Legally serve the battle against pollution; strengthen environmental resources adjudication; properly adjudicate various environmental resources cases; severely punish environmental pollution crimes; advance the improvement of the environmental public interest litigation system; improve the procedural system for ecological environmental damage compensation; innovate the methods of liability for ecological restoration; advance cross-regional judicial cooperation and full-basin collaborative governance; improve the adjudication system and mechanism for environmental resources.

11. Legally serve supply-side structural reform. Focus on the disposal of "zombie enterprises"; strengthen bankruptcy adjudication work; advance the professionalization and informatization of bankruptcy adjudication; promote the improvement of the market entity rescue and exit mechanism; use legalized means to consolidate and guarantee the in-depth advancement of the "three reductions, one increase, one supplement" (reducing overcapacity, destocking, deleveraging, lowering costs, and strengthening weak links). Legally and properly adjudicate cases involving advanced manufacturing and various new business models, models, and forms; accurately grasp the standards of adjudication; promote the reduction of enterprise costs; serve the transformation of old and new growth drivers and the improvement of the industrial chain. Legally adjudicate cases involving companies, contracts, investments, and market competition; legally regulate various monopolistic and unfair competition behaviors; promote the formation of fair, open, and transparent market rules. Deeply implement the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments on optimizing the business environment; benchmark against the World Bank's business environment assessment indicator system; take effective measures to improve the assessment results of relevant judicial indicators; actively create a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable rule-of-law business environment.

12. Legally serve the development of the private economy. Intensify judicial protection of property rights; adhere to treating all market entities equally and providing equal protection; accurately grasp policy directions and work standards; properly adjudicate various cases involving property rights; legally and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of private enterprises and entrepreneurs. Improve the normalization mechanism for identifying and correcting wrongful cases involving enterprises; solidly carry out work on the legal identification and correction of wrongful cases involving property rights and state compensation; firmly establish concepts of modesty, prudence, and good faith; strictly prevent acts infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of enterprises; so that entrepreneurs can focus on starting businesses, confidently invest, and manage with peace of mind.

13. Legally serve the construction of an innovative country. Fully leverage the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights; resolutely and legally punish all types of intellectual property infringement; improve the system for damages in intellectual property infringement cases; correctly apply the punitive damages system; optimize the legal environment for scientific and technological innovation. Strengthen the construction of the Intellectual Property Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court; further improve the overall layout and organizational system of intellectual property adjudication; strengthen the professionalization of the intellectual property adjudication team; enhance the capacity and level of intellectual property adjudication. Actively participate in constructing international intellectual property protection rules and promoting the reform of the international intellectual property governance system; enhance China's voice and leadership in international governance rules; strive to build China into a benchmark for world intellectual property protection and a preferred venue for litigation.

14. Legally serve the construction of an open economy. Focus on the implementation of national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, the maritime power strategy, pilot free trade zones, free trade ports, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area; leverage the role of the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court and the International Commercial Expert Committee; improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism; provide high-quality and efficient judicial services. In line with the national comprehensive implementation of policies such as the pre-establishment national treatment plus negative list management system; adhere to strictly and equally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties in accordance with the law; promote the liberalization and facilitation of trade and investment.

15. Deepen international judicial exchanges and cooperation. Fully leverage the advantages of adjudicative operations; actively participate in the formulation of relevant international rules; strengthen exchanges and cooperation with international organizations such as the World Bank, the World Intellectual Property Organization, and the World Trade Organization. Improve the system and mechanism for international judicial assistance; enhance the professional level of reviewing and handling international judicial assistance cases.

IV. Adhere to the People-Centered Development Philosophy, Strive to Meet the Growing Judicial Needs of the People

16. Strengthen judicial protection of people's livelihood. Focus on prominent conflicts and issues in the field of people's livelihood; properly adjudicate cases involving the vital interests of the people, such as education, employment, medical care, elderly care, and childcare; deeply advance the reform of family adjudication. Strengthen work on safeguarding the rights of military personnel; effectively protect national defense interests and the legitimate rights and interests of military personnel and their families; serve the integrated development of the military and civilian sectors. Increase efforts in building a lawyer service platform; deeply advance pilot projects such as lawyer mediation; promote lawyers to play a greater role in handling petitions and acting as agents in appeals.

17. Strengthen administrative adjudication work. Fully leverage the function of administrative adjudication; legally protect the legitimate rights and interests of administrative counterparts; promote the substantive resolution of administrative disputes; serve and support the reform of "streamlining administration, delegating power, strengthening regulation, and improving services"; support and supervise administrative agencies in exercising their powers according to law. Strictly implement the Administrative Procedure Law and its judicial interpretations; implement systems such as incidental review of normative documents; strengthen supervision and guidance; enhance the capacity and level of administrative adjudication. Improve the system of jurisdiction over administrative cases that is appropriately separated from administrative divisions; optimize the allocation of administrative adjudication resources; deepen the reform of the administrative adjudication system and mechanism.

18. Strengthen state compensation and judicial assistance work. Properly adjudicate various types of state compensation cases; improve the state compensation system and working mechanism; enhance the level of state compensation work. Centering on the goal of "legalizing the assistance system and judicializing assistance cases"; improve the judicial assistance working mechanism; better leverage the role of judicial assistance.

19. Strengthen adjudication work involving Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and overseas Chinese. Properly adjudicate cases involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan; strengthen inter-regional judicial assistance and cooperation; legally and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of compatriots from Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. Fully leverage the roles of platforms such as the Chinese Judicial Research Association; promote the integration and cohesion of Chinese judicial culture. Advance pilot projects for diversified resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese; legally adjudicate cases involving overseas Chinese; protect the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and their relatives.

20. Vigorously promote core socialist values. Through impartial adjudication, establish behavioral rules and guide social trends; let those who obey the law and discipline stand tall, and those who violate the law and lose virtue have no room to move. Conscientiously implement the Law on the Protection of Heroes and Martyrs; legally sanction illegal acts such as infringing upon the rights and interests of heroes and martyrs and desecrating their images; use judicial means to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs. Conscientiously implement the responsibility system for legal popularization; strengthen legal publicity and education through means such as open court trials, explaining the law through cases, serving as vice principals for legal affairs in primary and secondary schools, and circuit trials; enhance the public's concept of the rule of law; promote the spirit of the rule of law. Conscientiously implement the guiding opinions on strengthening and standardizing the reasoning of legal judgment documents; improve the level of reasoning explanation and the quality of judgment documents.

V. Consolidate the Achievements of "Basically Solving the Difficulty of Enforcement," Maintain High-Level Operation of Enforcement Work

21. Ensure the timely achievement of the goal of "basically solving the difficulty of enforcement." Further intensify enforcement efforts; continuously improve the quality and efficiency of enforcement; weave a tight credit punishment net; make "deadbeats" have nowhere to hide; resolutely detain and impose criminal penalties according to law on those who have the ability to enforce but refuse to enforce judgments and rulings; form a more powerful deterrent. Concentrate efforts with the spirit of driving nails to focus on key points, fill shortcomings, and strengthen weaknesses; ensure that enforcement work stands up to scrutiny. Accelerate the resolution of enforcement-related petition conflicts; leverage the role of enforcement assistance; further enhance the people's sense of gain and satisfaction. Widely publicize the work of tackling "basically solving the difficulty of enforcement"; guide the public to enhance risk awareness and understanding of enforcement work; correctly understand "inability to enforce"; more extensively gather social consensus.

22. Promote the normalization and institutionalization of the achievements and experiences of enforcement work. Persist in continuing efforts after tackling the difficulty without slackening; promptly consolidate the achievements of "basically solving the difficulty of enforcement." Improve the online asset investigation and control system; continuously expand the scope of online asset investigation and control; strengthen the functions of freezing and garnishment; promote the full coverage of various types of property by the online asset investigation and control system. Improve the online asset evaluation and auction system; increase the application of online auctions; enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of asset realization. Increase the application of litigation preservation; strengthen the coordination and cooperation of filing, adjudication, and enforcement; the segregation of simple and complex cases; and the smooth connection between enforcement and bankruptcy. Strictly standardize the procedure for concluding enforcement cases; firmly grasp the key indicator of the qualification rate of concluded enforcement cases; establish and improve a management mechanism for concluded enforcement cases that strictly controls entry, standardizes management, smooths exit, and allows orderly withdrawal.

23. Accelerate the improvement of a long-term mechanism for enforcement work. Closely rely on Party committees and political and legal affairs committees at all levels; better leverage the advantages of the Party's leadership and the socialist system's ability to concentrate resources on major tasks; improve the overall pattern of comprehensive management of enforcement difficulties. Strengthen overall planning; formulate a five-year development outline for enforcement work; improve the top-level design for the long-term development of enforcement work. Deeply advance joint punishment work; strengthen network integration and information sharing with cooperating units; embed dishonesty lists and punishment measures into business processes; achieve more automatic identification, automatic interception, and automatic punishment. Carefully summarize enforcement work experience; cooperate with the National People's Congress in the legislative work on the Law on Compulsory Enforcement; promote the establishment of a personal bankruptcy system; improve enforcement assistance, especially insurance assistance systems; strengthen the institutional safeguard for enforcement. Strengthen the concepts of fair, good-faith, and civilized enforcement; achieve precision and meticulousness in enforcement work; strictly enforce the law in a fair and impartial manner; ensure that enforcement work is more standardized and orderly.

VI. Comprehensively Advance the Modernization of Litigation Service Centers, Provide High-Quality, Efficient, and Convenient Judicial Services to the People

24. Adhere to innovatively developing the "Fengqiao experience" in the new era. Advance "source governance of litigation"; actively integrate judicial work into the social governance system under Party committee leadership, government responsibility, social coordination, public participation, and rule-of-law guarantee; move the work threshold forward, target the source of conflicts; achieve timely, efficient, and source-based resolution of conflicts and disputes; promote the construction of a governance pattern of joint contribution, joint governance, and shared benefits. Adhere to putting non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms upfront; under the leadership of the Party committee and political and legal affairs committee, promote the reduction of litigation increments from the source; allow a large number of conflicts to be digested in the bud through front-end prevention and control systems; resolve most disputes through non-litigation procedures with social forces; allow courts to focus on adjudicating cases of greater normative significance; truly make justice the last line of defense for maintaining social fairness and justice.

25. Improve the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Actively carry out reform of "separation, mediation, fast-track, and trial"; improve a diversified dispute resolution system with organic connection and mutual coordination among mediation, arbitration, administrative adjudication, administrative reconsideration, and litigation; promote conflict resolution. Actively carry out pre-litigation diversion of conflicts and disputes; provide multiple dispute resolution solutions and channels for litigants; introduce the advantages and characteristics of different dispute resolution procedures in ways that the public likes; continuously broaden dispute resolution channels. Strengthen the intensive operation of trial and enforcement support tasks; advance the intensive management of trial support tasks; innovate and improve the mechanism for socialized purchased services; entrust judicial auxiliary tasks suitable for social forces to market entities and social forces; help grassroots courts reduce burdens and increase efficiency.

26. Explore new litigation models in the mobile internet era. Carefully sum up and promote the experience of the Zhejiang Mobile Micro-Court pilot; promote the deep integration of modern technology and judicial adjudication; increase the proportion and application level of electronic litigation; explore new litigation tools in the internet and mobile internet era. Comprehensively improve the level of informatization and intelligence of litigation services; accelerate the reform of cross-regional case-filing litigation services; optimize online litigation service functions; promote remote handling of litigation matters across regions and coordinated handling across levels; solve difficulties in handling litigation in different locations. Deepen the application of various online dispute resolution platforms; integrate and optimize online and offline dispute resolution resources; continuously improve the intelligent level of dispute resolution.

VII. Deepening Judicial System Reform and Smart Court Construction, Promoting Modernization of Trial System and Trial Capability

27. Fully implementing the judicial accountability system. Implement the implementation opinions on further comprehensively implementing the judicial accountability system, implement the requirement of "letting those who adjudicate the case decide, and those who decide be held accountable," so that judges can focus their energy on fulfilling their duties and handling cases well. Improve the system of presiding judge meetings and the adjudication committee, comprehensively promote the normalization of court presidents and division chiefs handling cases, strengthen the construction of trial teams in basic people's courts, clarify the job responsibilities of all types of personnel, and better achieve that each person is in their proper position and performs their respective duties. Coordinate the supporting reform measures of the judicial accountability system, and further strengthen policy interpretation and guidance. Strengthen the training and deployment of judge assistants and clerks. Actively and steadily promote judge disciplinary work, adhere to the principle of proportionality between responsibility and fault, and the combination of discipline and education, to promote judges to perform their duties in accordance with the law. Further study and improve the mechanism for supervising and restricting the operation of trial power, refine work measures, and enhance the synergy and effectiveness of supervision.

28. Comprehensively deepening the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system. Effectively grasp the implementation of reform tasks deployed by the central government, and ensure that various reform measures achieve tangible results. Issue the "Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reform of the Judicial System of People's Courts – The Fifth Five-Year Reform Outline of People's Courts (2019-2023)," and comprehensively deepen the reform of people's courts. Persist in the reform goals with the spirit of driving a nail without relaxing, carry out deep processing of reform measures that affect the overall situation, pay attention to fine decoration of supporting reforms that need timely follow-up, strengthen supervision and inspection of reform measures being implemented, conduct "look-back" on reform measures that have been implemented for a period of time, strengthen reform supervision and evaluation, effectively solve the problems of "temperature difference" and unbalanced development existing in various places, and ensure that reforms are implemented and effective.

29. Improving the organizational system and institutional setup of people's courts. Optimize the functional positioning of the four levels of courts, further clarify the functional divisions and work priorities of people's courts at all levels. Deepen the construction of the circuit courts of the Supreme People's Court, the Intellectual Property Court, as well as trans-administrative region courts, intellectual property courts, internet courts, and financial courts, to promote a more optimized, coordinated, and efficient organizational system of people's courts. Coordinate the advancement of internal institutional reforms, promote the optimization of trial functions and the flattening of internal management.

30. Improving the litigation system. Deepen the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on the trial, fully implement the principles of division of responsibilities, mutual cooperation, and mutual restraint, and work with relevant units to improve the work system of performing respective duties, cooperating effectively, and restraining effectively. Implement the "three procedures" of pre-trial conferences, exclusion of illegally obtained evidence, and court investigations, improve the mechanism for witnesses, investigators, and expert witnesses to testify in court, and promote the substantiation of court trials. Improve the leniency system for admitting guilt and accepting punishment in criminal proceedings, improve the trial mechanism supporting speed procedures, summary procedures, and ordinary procedures, so that cases are diverted by complexity, separated by severity, and handled at different speeds, optimize the allocation of judicial resources, and effectively improve judicial efficiency.

31. Comprehensively building a Smart Court. Promote the deep integration of scientific and technological innovations such as big data and artificial intelligence with judicial work, comprehensively advance intelligent-assisted case handling based on electronic case files, strive to overcome a number of key technologies marked by smart court artificial intelligence technology, and vigorously promote the construction of "smart adjudication, smart enforcement, smart services, and smart management." Solidly advance the simultaneous generation and in-depth use of electronic case files with cases, establish work norms and standards covering the entire process of trial and enforcement, realize intelligent reminders and simultaneous supervision, and ensure that case handling work operates entirely online. Enrich and expand judicial data resources, expand the service functions of judicial big data, and provide useful references and services for leadership decision-making, trial enforcement, and social governance. Seriously implement opinions on further deepening judicial openness, improve the system and mechanism for judicial openness, and further improve the open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient sunshine judicial mechanism.

32. Strengthening trial management. Strictly manage trial time limits, resolutely clean up and correct criminal cases involving long-term detention without trial and long-pending civil cases. Use methods such as situation analysis, meeting reviews, and case scheduling to promote the improvement of trial and enforcement work efficiency of people's courts at all levels, and promote the formation of a good situation of balanced caseload and a virtuous cycle of case acceptance and resolution. Give play to the roles of the adjudication committee, court presidents and division chiefs, and specialized trial management institutions, and strengthen trial supervision and management. Actively apply trial information big data, and unify trial concepts and judicial standards through means such as retrieval of similar cases and related cases, guidance of adjudication rules, and publication of typical cases. Improve the trial performance evaluation mechanism to promote judicial justice and efficiency.

33. Strengthening investigation and research. Strengthen work coordination, correctly handle the relationship between trial enforcement and investigation and research, experience summarization, and trial guidance, strengthen the transformation of research results, and serve the scientific decision-making of people's courts. Scientifically set up comprehensive business institutions of people's courts, and strengthen guidance on research work. Strengthen the construction of research talent teams, improve the training, use, and exchange mechanisms for research talents, and enhance the quality and capability of research teams.

VIII. Accelerating the Construction of a Revolutionary, Regularized, Professional, and Professionalized Team, Forging a Strong Court Team for the New Era

34. Flipping the banner and placing political construction in the first place. In accordance with the unified deployment of the Party Central Committee, solidly carry out the theme education of "staying true to the original aspiration and keeping the mission firmly in mind." Seriously implement the "Regulations on the Work of Party Branches of the Communist Party of China (Trial)," deeply implement the project to enhance the organizational capacity of grassroots party organizations, vigorously promote the standardization and regularization of party branches, and effectively build grassroots party organizations of people's courts at all levels into strong fighting fortresses. Strengthen education on political discipline and political rules, solidly carry out political rotation training and political supervision, and create a healthy and upright political ecosystem. Strictly implement the Party Constitution and other intra-Party regulations, strictly implement the Several Guidelines on Intra-Party Political Life under the New Situation, earnestly implement systems such as "three meetings and one class," democratic life meetings, and heart-to-heart talks, adhere to the good use of criticism and self-criticism as a weapon, and strive to create a positive and healthy intra-Party political culture.

35. Striving to enhance judicial capability. Seriously implement the standards for good cadres in the new era, adhere to the correct orientation of selecting and employing people, improve incentive mechanisms and mechanisms for tolerating and correcting errors that conform to the characteristics of the judicial profession, and strengthen the cultivation and selection of young cadres. Focus on cultivating the fighting spirit of police officers, especially young cadres, and plan to have police officers temper themselves in the practice of responding to emergencies and handling complex situations. Firmly establish the concept of fairness and justice, adhere to facts as the basis and law as the criterion, strengthen awareness of evidence, procedures, authority, and conscious acceptance of supervision, and effectively maintain judicial justice. Place the construction of specialization in a more important position, pay close attention to the construction of judicial capability, and comprehensively enhance the judicial ability and level of police officers. Adhere to judicial conscience, always remember the fundamental purpose of justice for the people, consciously restrict oneself with the professional ethics of judges, and strictly and impartially administer justice.

36. Strengthening guarantee for performing duties. Further implement various policies and measures for preferential treatment of police officers, work with relevant departments to strengthen guarantee for performing duties, provide special care, and do everything possible to help solve various practical difficulties, so that police officers can feel secure, at ease, and stable in their work. Encourage and support police officers to take responsibility and act, and adhere to strict and fair justice. Strengthen work on veteran cadres, so that veteran cadres have a greater sense of honor politically, a greater sense of belonging organizationally, and a greater sense of happiness in life. Vigorously strengthen the construction of court culture, and give full play to the role of culture in uniting people, improving management, nourishing teams, establishing image, and promoting work.

37. Promoting the comprehensive and deepening development of strict governance of the Party and strict governance of the court. Strictly implement the spirit of the Central Committee's Eight-Point Regulation and its implementation rules, resolutely prevent and overcome all formalism and bureaucracy, and unremittingly correct the "four forms of decadence." Further improve and implement ironclad rules and prohibitions such as the "five prohibitions," preventing interference in cases, and regulating interactions between judicial personnel and relevant persons. Improve the strict management and supervision system for court teams, solidly carry out internal inspections, judicial inspections, and trial affairs supervision, increase the frequency of regular supervision and comprehensive management of police officers, tighten the "iron cage of systems" and the "iron cage of data," resolutely prevent "lamp black," and promote the long-term mechanism of not daring, not being able, and not wanting to be corrupt within the court system as a whole. Adhere to turning the knife inward and scraping the bone to cure the poison, adhere to the principle that every case must be investigated, every corruption must be punished, and every corrupt act must be punished, resolutely eliminate bad apples, and ensure fair justice with integrity and honesty.

IX. Strengthening the Work of People's Tribunals, Further Consolidating the Grassroots Foundation

38. Fully utilizing the functions of people's tribunals. Persist in making grassroots foundation construction a top priority, consolidate the grassroots foundation, and enhance grassroots judicial capabilities and guarantee levels. Adjudicate agricultural-related cases in accordance with the law, and effectively strengthen the protection of farmers' rights and interests. Actively promote the "Xunwu experience," combine judicial work with village rules and regulations, local customs and folkways, promote the improvement of a rural governance system combining autonomy, rule of law, and rule of virtue, and promote the modernization of the rural governance system and governance capacity.

39. Strengthening the construction of the working mechanism of people's tribunals. Adhere to the principles of "three orientations" and "two conveniences," seriously study and refine the new connotations of the "two conveniences" principle in the new era, promote circuit trials, vehicle-mounted courts, and mobile backpack technology courts, so that the people can truly feel the fairness, warmth, and convenience of justice. Further optimize the layout of people's tribunals, and build people's tribunals into the front-line highlands of judicial work in the new era. Relying on people's tribunals, strengthen effective connection with government departments, grassroots self-governing organizations, and grassroots people's mediation committees, strengthen professional guidance for people's mediation, and form a joint force for resolving conflicts and disputes at the source.

40. Strengthening the self-construction of people's tribunals. Strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations as the key starting point for grasping the grassroots and building the foundation, regard people's tribunals as an important platform for cadre training and growth, promote the flow of policy resources to people's tribunals, so that the vast majority of tribunal police officers can better base themselves on their posts and start businesses. Focus on solving the practical problems and difficulties faced by people's tribunals, such as security protection and information construction, to ensure the smooth development of grassroots basic work. Strengthen the work of people's courts in assisting Tibet and Xinjiang, help courts and tribunals in remote and economically underdeveloped areas improve working conditions, and promote the enhancement of grassroots judicial levels.

X. Consciously Accepting Supervision, Continuously Improving the Work of People's Courts

41. Strengthening communication and liaison with deputies to the People's Congress and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC). Enhance the awareness of actively accepting supervision, continuously sum up experience, further improve the communication and liaison working mechanism with deputies and members, innovate methods and means of communication and liaison, carry out communication and liaison work efficiently and conveniently, and smooth the channels of communication with public opinion. By inviting deputies to the People's Congress to inspect court work, attend meetings, and observe trials, carefully listen to opinions and suggestions. Actively visit and receive members of the CPPCC National Committee, strengthen communication with democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party personages, and extensively adopt opinions from all sides.

42. Seriously handling suggestions from deputies and proposals from CPPCC members. Solidly do a good job in handling suggestions from deputies to the National People's Congress and proposals from members of the CPPCC National Committee, establish and improve work records, refine division of labor plans, strengthen supervision and urging, promptly report the progress and results of handling to deputies and members, strengthen communication and explanation work, and strive to gain understanding and support from deputies and members.

43. Seriously preparing for the special report on criminal trial work to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Seriously summarize the experience of criminal trial work in recent years, actively carry out investigation and research, promptly put forward opinions and suggestions, and do a good job in preparing the special report. Take the special report as an opportunity to promote the resolution of bottlenecks restricting the development of criminal trials, and continuously enhance the capability and level of criminal trial work.

People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with these key points and in light of actual work, decompose tasks, pay close attention to implementation, strive for practical results, ensure the successful completion of the year's work tasks, faithfully fulfill the duties conferred by the Constitution and laws, and greet the 70th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China with outstanding achievements.
